title: Making the most of not that relevant experience as an aspiring psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到更多钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我提供的独家支持礼包，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森特产以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, that's your side.
sentences.zh: 通过这个播客，这就是你的方向。

sentences.en: You'll be on your wish with the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你将在玛丽安·特伦特博士的“有志心理学家播客”中实现你的愿望。

sentences.en: Welcome along to this first ever Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听第一期“有志心理学家播客”。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I am hoping that you're going to find this a really useful resource.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我希望你们会发现这是一个非常实用的资源。

sentences.en: So I am a clinical psychologist, and I know that in your position, when it was my time to be an aspiring clinical psychologist, that I would have found this really useful.
sentences.zh: 我是一名临床心理学家，我知道在你们的立场上，当我还是一个有志成为临床心理学家的时候，我会觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: So I hope you do too, but please do feel free to get in contact with me and shape this, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你们也这么觉得，但请随时与我联系并塑造这个播客。

sentences.en: So make this what you want.
sentences.zh: 所以，把它变成你想要的样子。

sentences.en: So I'm aiming that the podcasts are all going to be, you know, similar length, not any longer really than 20 minutes, unless I've got interviews happening,
sentences.zh: 我的目标是让每集播客的长度都差不多，基本上不超过20分钟，除非我有安排采访，

sentences.en: often as short as sort of 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 通常短至10分钟左右。

sentences.en: But they're not scripted, I've got ideas of what I will be talking about, but I'm going to be drawing on current themes in psychology and thinking about, you know,
sentences.zh: 但它们是没有剧本的，我对要谈论的内容有一些想法，但我将借鉴心理学领域的当前主题，思考，

sentences.en: current events and also issues that are really pertinent to you as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 时事以及真正与你们这些有志心理学家息息相关的问题。

sentences.en: So who are you, you know, in my mind, you are quite possibly already graduated in your undergraduate psychology degree.
sentences.zh: 那么你是谁呢？在我看来，你很可能已经获得了心理学本科学位。

sentences.en: And, you know, you are maybe working in some kind of relevant industry, trying to gain some experience, or you may be, you know, as I have been in the past,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可能在某个相关行业工作，试图积累一些经验，或者你可能像我过去一样，

sentences.en: you may be in something that doesn't feel terrifically relevant.
sentences.zh: 你可能从事着一份感觉不怎么相关的工作。

sentences.en: So I worked for quite a long time at Argos head office.
sentences.zh: 我在阿尔戈斯（Argos）总公司工作了很长时间。

sentences.en: So I'm originally from the Milton Keynes area.
sentences.zh: 我原本来自米尔顿凯恩斯地区。

sentences.en: And that is where you could find me having a lovely time with my colleagues, doing my job very well, but actually punching into that phone system at, you know, 8.59 a.m.,
sentences.zh: 那就是你能找到我的地方，我和同事们过得很开心，工作也非常出色，实际上是在，你知道的，早上8点59分打卡进入电话系统，

sentences.en: seeing that clock tick over to 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 看着时钟跳到早上9点。

sentences.en: And thinking, oh, dear Lord, I cannot wait to see that clock say 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 然后心想，天哪，我迫不及待地想看到时钟显示下午5点，

sentences.en: so I can punch out again.
sentences.zh: 这样我就可以再次打卡下班了。

sentences.en: So I feel like I've always had the ability to make the most of whatever situation that I find myself in.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我一直有一种能力，能充分利用我发现自己所处的任何情况。

sentences.en: So I did, you know, there are aspects of that job that I really enjoyed.
sentences.zh: 我确实，你知道的，那份工作有些方面我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: And it certainly showed me, you know, really useful skills about how to do the customer service role, but for stores.
sentences.zh: 它确实向我展示了非常有用的技能，关于如何为店铺扮演好客户服务角色。

sentences.en: And so when stores are having a hard time or needed problems with, you know, stock or sorting something out, they would call me.
sentences.zh: 所以当门店遇到困难或需要解决库存问题或理清某些事情时，他们会打电话给我。

sentences.en: I can't even remember what the team was called.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不记得那个团队叫什么了。

sentences.en: It was a while ago, but, you know, I was decent at the job.
sentences.zh: 那是很久以前的事了，但你知道的，我工作干得不错。

sentences.en: I got good feedback from my managers and, you know, popular with my team.
sentences.zh: 我得到了经理的好评，而且在团队里很受欢迎。

sentences.en: And, you know, the ability to play office chair Olympics was definitely around when the phone lines were quieter.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，在电话线较安静的时候，玩办公椅奥运会的技能肯定是存在的。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I made the most of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我充分利用了它。

sentences.en: And also at that time, Argos head office had free vend on their drinks vending machine and their hot chocolate was really rather good.
sentences.zh: 而且当时，阿尔戈斯总公司的饮料自动售货机是免费供应的，他们的热巧克力真的相当不错。

sentences.en: And also their vegetable soup and chicken soup was pretty good, too.
sentences.zh: 还有他们的蔬菜汤和鸡汤也相当不错。

sentences.en: So I'd often have a hot chocolate or a little cup of soup, you know, around 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常在10点左右喝一杯热巧克力或一小杯汤。

sentences.en: And I used to like a late lunch.
sentences.zh: 我过去喜欢晚一点吃午饭。

sentences.en: I used to like a late lunch.
sentences.zh: 我过去喜欢晚一点吃午饭。

sentences.en: I'd go to lunch about two o'clock because, of course, if you've ever worked in a phone or customer service call center,
sentences.zh: 我大概两点钟去吃午饭，因为当然，如果你在电话或客户服务呼叫中心工作过，

sentences.en: you have to stagger your lunches because you need to make sure there's always enough people to be able to answer the phone.
sentences.zh: 你必须错开午餐时间，因为你需要确保总有足够的人能够接听电话。

sentences.en: So I'd nominate myself to have a late lunch, which would be two till three.
sentences.zh: 所以我毛遂自荐吃晚午饭，也就是两点到三点。

sentences.en: And then I'd get back and I'd only have two hours left winning.
sentences.zh: 然后我回来时，就只剩下两个小时的赢面了。

sentences.en: I think I also got a tea break.
sentences.zh: 我想我还有一个茶歇。

sentences.en: I think the breaks weren't paid.
sentences.zh: 我想休息时间是不带薪的。

sentences.en: I can't remember.
sentences.zh: 我不记得了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I had great fun and actually got really lovely memories of the day that one of my managers wound up one of my friends who had C's,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我玩得很开心，实际上对那天的一件事记忆犹新：我的一个经理捉弄了我的一个朋友，他的名字里有C、S和T，她居然撬开键盘按键并把它们换了位置，因为她知道他的打字水平不是很高。

sentences.en: S's and T's in his name and actually prized off the keys and swapped them around because she knew that his typing wasn't that brilliant.
sentences.zh: 所以每次他在为客户通话记录的笔记末尾打出自己的名字时，都是错的。

sentences.en: And so every time he typed his name at the end of a note that he'd recorded for a client call, it was wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以他的名字，我来告诉你，他的名字叫克里斯·阿诺特（Chris Arnott），但他不明白为什么每次他打出自己的名字时，出来的都是“Crit Arnos”。

sentences.en: So his name, I'm going to tell you, his name was Chris Arnott, but it couldn't work out why every time he typed his name, it was coming out as Crit Arnos.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，这依然让我微笑。

sentences.en: And it still makes me smile to this day.
sentences.zh: 我还在说话。

sentences.en: I still speak.
sentences.zh: 我依然在想你，Crit Arnos。

sentences.en: I still think about you, Crit Arnos.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我想正如他们所说，这叫学会在阳光普照时收割干草。

sentences.en: I think there's learning to make hay while the sun shines, as they say.
sentences.zh: 所以即使你没有身处感觉那么相关的行业，思考如何将其转化为你的优势，如何，

sentences.en: So even if you're not in, you know, an industry that feels that relevant, it is important to think about how you can turn it to your advantage, how you can, you know,
sentences.zh: 也许要求承担更多责任，这很重要。

sentences.en: perhaps ask for some more responsibility.
sentences.zh: 所以我实际上意识到，我的技能可能稍微高了一点，我没有开足马力，我并没有在那个职位上充分使用我的全部脑力。

sentences.en: So I recognised actually, you know, my skills were perhaps a little bit above, you know, I wasn't firing on all cylinders, I wasn't using all of my brain power in that role.
sentences.zh: 所以我请求承担额外的职责，负责查看通话数据以及在岗员工的数据。

sentences.en: And so I asked to have additional responsibilities of looking at the data for the calls and for looking at, you know, the data for the staff on duty.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这意味着我能够从那个电话系统中登出，这也意味着在我的自身数据中，我的踪迹更难被追踪到了。

sentences.en: And actually, you know, it meant that I was able to punch out of that phone system, which meant that I was less traceable as well in my own data.
sentences.zh: 所以当经理在处理数据时，

sentences.en: So when the manager was doing the data,
sentences.zh: 你的收件箱里会收到一些信息，上面写着你登录了多少分钟、你的平均通话时长是多少以及你通话之间的间隔有多久。

sentences.en: you'd get things in your inbox saying that you'd been logged in for how many minutes and what your average call length was and how much gaps you were having between calls.
sentences.zh: 但是当我接手所有这些额外有趣的工作时，这实际上意味着我的数据完全是一派胡言。

sentences.en: But when I took on all this extra juicy, it actually meant that my data was completely bunkum.
sentences.zh: 它没有任何意义，因为我当然有很大一部分时间没有登录，这扭曲了数据。

sentences.en: It didn't make any sense because, of course, I wasn't logged in for large portions, which skewed the data.
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着我的经理其实并不知道我在忙什么，尽管这是一个共享办公室，所以他们可以看到我在做什么。

sentences.en: And so it meant my manager didn't really know what I was up to, even though it was a shared office, so they could see what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 但这只是让我稍微松了松油门，你知道的，寻找了一点喘息的空间。

sentences.en: But it just allowed me to take my foot off that gas pedal, you know, a little bit and to find a little bit of breathing room.
sentences.zh: 而且，听这个节目的你们，可能会发现自己身处一个要求极高的岗位中。

sentences.en: And, you know, those of you who are listening to this, you may find that you are in a really highly demanding role.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能，也许身处IAPT（抑郁焦虑心理治疗）服务或类似机构中。

sentences.en: So you might be, you know, perhaps in an IAPT service or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你的时间可能面临非常非常高的要求，要找到那种喘息的空间真的很难。

sentences.en: You might have real, real high demands on your time and it's really hard to catch that breathing space.
sentences.zh: 但无论你的职位如何，你可能仍然能够思考如何运用你独特的技能和才华，

sentences.en: But you might still, regardless of your role, be able to think about how you could use your unique skills and talents,
sentences.zh: 即使你从事的是一份相关的心理学工作，也要真正让自己脱颖而出，并帮助你获得相关的经验。

sentences.en: even if it is a relevant psychology role that you're working in, to really, you know, be able to help yourself stand out and to help you to gain that relevant experience.
sentences.zh: 所以这本该是对播客、对我和你为什么想要收听的介绍。

sentences.en: So this was supposed to be an introduction to the podcast and to me and why you might want to listen.
sentences.zh: 但我已经忍不住要与你分享信息了。

sentences.en: And already I can't help myself but share information with you.
sentences.zh: 让我给你讲一个最近联系过我的人的典型一天。

sentences.en: So let me give you a typical day for someone that had contacted me recently.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，这向我们展示了你可能会申请什么工作，或者你在试图推进心理学职业生涯的同时目前可能在做什么工作。

sentences.en: Because, you know, this shows us just what jobs you might be applying to or what jobs you might be doing currently whilst trying to further your career in psychology.
sentences.zh: 早上9点，一个复杂的预约，所以10点30分结束。

sentences.en: 9 a.m., an appointment which was complex, so finished at 10.30.
sentences.zh: 10点30分，为该预约写笔记。

sentences.en: 10.30, notes for that appointment.
sentences.zh: 上午11点，一个预约。

sentences.en: 11 a.m., an appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以那将是一个客户预约。

sentences.en: So that would be a client appointment.
sentences.zh: 中午12点，我的经理想要谈谈一个正在休病假的被督导者。

sentences.en: 12 p.m., my manager wanted to talk about a supervisee who's on sick leave.
sentences.zh: 12点30分，与另一个被督导者进行我自己的直线管理（1对1督导）。

sentences.en: 12.30, my own line management with another supervisee.
sentences.zh: 下午1点，与另一个被督导者进行督导。

sentences.en: 1 p.m., supervision with another supervisee.
sentences.zh: 两点钟，同上。

sentences.en: 2 o'clock, same as above.
sentences.zh: 下午3点，个人咨询。

sentences.en: 3 p.m., personal counselling.
sentences.zh: 下午4点30分，与被督导者进行直线管理。

sentences.en: And 4.30, line management with a supervisee.
sentences.zh: 在背景中，还有职业健康政策以及照顾这个人团队福祉的相关事务。

sentences.en: And in the background, there was occupational health policy and stuff for looking after the well-being of this person's team.
sentences.zh: 这是一份忙碌的工作，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's a busy job, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在卫生服务部门确实对许多担任有志心理学家角色的人要求很高。

sentences.en: So we are absolutely in the health service asking a lot of people working in, you know, in roles who are aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，我们知道作为一名有志心理学家，你确实拥有独特的技能和才华。

sentences.en: So, of course, we know that as an aspiring psychologist, you do have unique skills and talents.
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是，我们要确保我们没有被要求超出我们能力范围的工作。

sentences.en: But it's also important that we make sure that we're not being asked to work outside of our competencies.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，任何处于那种高要求职位的人都会觉得那是个相当大的要求。

sentences.en: You know, anybody in that kind of demanding role would find that, you know, quite an ask.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，即使是我这个合格的心理学家，也会觉得那是非常苛刻的一天。

sentences.en: You know, even me in my role as a qualified psychologist would find that a pretty demanding day.
sentences.zh: 所以在国民保健署（NHS）时，在我最近的一份工作中，我能够自主安排我的时间。

sentences.en: So when I was in the NHS, I was able to structure my own time in my most recent job.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以管理我自己的日程表，只要我能证明我显然每周接待了相应数量的客户，并且我的病例量中有足够多的客户。

sentences.en: So I'd manage my own diary so long as I was able to demonstrate that I was obviously seeing, you know, the number of clients per week and had enough clients on my caseload.
sentences.zh: 但是为了达到50%的面对面时间。

sentences.en: But to kind of achieve 50% face-to-face time.
sentences.zh: 所以这通常很常见。

sentences.en: So that's often quite common.
sentences.zh: 但我知道在全国范围内，比我资历浅的职位被期望拥有高得多的面对面比例。

sentences.en: But I know that across the country, roles more junior than mine are being expected to have a much higher face-to-face ratio.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很有挑战性。

sentences.en: But that's really challenging.
sentences.zh: 我们必须考虑这作为个人对你付出了什么代价，你知道的，因为实际上，

sentences.en: And we have to think about at what cost to you as an individual, you know, because actually, you know,
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢我的工作的其中一点，就是能够把人们记在心里，并拥有那些随机的连接时刻，我会，

sentences.en: one of my favourite things about my job is the ability to hold people in mind and to have, you know, those random moments of connection where I'll be, you know,
sentences.zh: 做一些诸如处理一些文书工作或写笔记之类的事情，或者我甚至可能，在下班后为我的孩子们切胡萝卜。

sentences.en: doing something like some paperwork or writing up the notes or I might even be, you know, off duty chopping carrots for my children.
sentences.zh: 如果你是父母，难道只有我一个人似乎在没完没了地削胡萝卜和切甜椒吗？

sentences.en: If you are a parent, is it just me who seems to be perpetually peeling carrots and chopping peppers?
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们不是蔬菜大户，但其中一个喜欢胡萝卜，另一个喜欢甜椒。

sentences.en: My children are not big vegetable eaters, but one of them likes carrots and one of them likes peppers.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就像没完没了的土拨鼠日（周而复始的枯燥日子）。

sentences.en: I feel like it's just a constant groundhog day.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果你对儿童能接受的蔬菜还有什么其他建议，也请尽管向我砸过来。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you've got any other advice for vegetables that are tolerated by children, also feel free to fling them my way.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这些都是要求很高的工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, these are demanding roles.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在切这些胡萝卜和甜椒的时候，我不必动用我的全部脑力。

sentences.en: And actually, whilst chopping these carrots and peppers, I don't have to use my full brain capacity.
sentences.zh: 我大概应该动用一下，免得切掉一根手指。

sentences.en: I probably should, as I might chop a finger off.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我喜欢它赋予我的灵活性、时间和空间，让我能够思考客户。

sentences.en: But, you know, I like the flexibility and the time and space that it gives me to be able to think about clients.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果我在跑步时看到某人，这让我想起我们在某次会话中谈过的事情，

sentences.en: So, you know, if I'm out on a run and I see someone and it reminds me of something we've spoken about, you know, in a session,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢能够把这些点连起来并反思我的客户的能力。

sentences.en: I like the ability to be able to join up the dots and to reflect on my client.
sentences.zh: 我实际上确实经常在这样做的时候告诉我的客户。

sentences.en: And I actually do often tell my clients when I have done that.
sentences.zh: 尤其是如果我参加了督导，有时我会告诉客户我在督导中谈论过他们。

sentences.en: And especially if I've been in supervision, sometimes I tell the client that I have spoken about them in supervision.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉他们，这并不是他们独有的。

sentences.en: But I tell them that, you know, that's not unique to them.
sentences.zh: 这不是我在说我做不了这份工作。

sentences.en: This isn't me saying I can't do this work.
sentences.zh: 这也不是我在说我不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: It isn't me saying I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我们这样想是为了试图真正推进这项工作，使其更加优化。

sentences.en: We're thinking about it as it being about, you know, trying to really advance this work to make it more optimal.
sentences.zh: 并且考虑到实际上为了我自己的职业发展，我的硬性要求是接受比我资深、比我有经验的人的督导。

sentences.en: And thinking about actually for my own professional development, it is a requirement that I am supervised by somebody more senior and more experienced than myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望这对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: So I hope that's useful for you.
sentences.zh: 拜托，如果你确实想要更多关于我如何与客户谈论某些事情的例子，请告诉我，我们可以围绕这个塑造一集播客。

sentences.en: And please, if you do want any more examples about how I talk to clients about certain things, do let me know and we can shape a podcast episode around that.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们今天结束之前，我想我应该向你多介绍一下我自己。

sentences.en: So before we finish for today, I thought I would tell you a little bit more about myself.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在知道我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，也曾在阿尔戈斯总公司工作过。

sentences.en: So you do know now that I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and have also worked in Argos head office.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，我并不是仅仅通过在阿尔戈斯总公司工作就成为了一名临床心理学家。

sentences.en: But clearly, I didn't get to be a clinical psychologist just from working in Argos head office.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在2011年获得资格的。

sentences.en: So I qualified in 2011.
sentences.zh: 所以我的培训始于2008年米德兰兹的一所大学。

sentences.en: So my training started at a university in the Midlands in 2008.
sentences.zh: 所以我在2007年填写了清算所（Clearinghouse）项目的临床心理学博士（D-ClinSci）申请表。

sentences.en: So I was filling out my D-ClinSci form for the Clearinghouse programs in 2007.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻我正在与你们对话，2021/2022学年的申请流程已经开启。

sentences.en: And I speak to you as the right now, as the process for the 2021 forward slash 2022 applications are open.
sentences.zh: 所以现在是申请季。

sentences.en: So it's application season.
sentences.zh: 所以是申请狂热期。

sentences.en: So application fever.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你在如何填写表格方面寻求任何支持或指导，请务必查看我在“良好思考心理服务”（Good Thinking Psychological Services）上的YouTube视频。

sentences.en: However, if you are looking for any support or guidance in how to complete your form, then do check out my YouTube videos on good thinking psychological services.
sentences.zh: 那里有一系列我在今年9月（即2021年）做的直播问答视频。

sentences.en: And there are a series of live Q&A videos that I did in September this year.
sentences.zh: 所以我还在去年（也就是2020年申请季）做了一些。
所以一定要去看看那些视频。

sentences.en: And I also did some in the application season last year.
sentences.zh: 此外，我是《临床心理学家集锦：对有志临床心理学家的建议与指导》（Clinical Psychologist Collective, Advice and Guidance for Aspiring Clinical Psychologists）的主要作者。

sentences.en: So the 2020 season as well.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能不是一个有志于成为临床心理学家的人。

sentences.en: So do check those out.
sentences.zh: 你可能是另一种有志心理学家。

sentences.en: And also, I am the lead author of the Clinical Psychologist Collective, Advice and Guidance for Aspiring Clinical Psychologists.
sentences.zh: 但我的专业领域是临床心理学。

sentences.en: So you might not be an aspiring clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们所讨论的事情有很多交集。

sentences.en: You might be a different sort of aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你仍然会发现这很有用。

sentences.en: But my expertise is clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，再见。

sentences.en: But of course, there is lots of crossover in the things that we are talking about.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，再见。

sentences.en: So I hope you will still find this useful.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，再见。

sentences.en: And yeah, do check out that book and check out those YouTube videos if you would welcome some guidance from, you know, from me,
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你希望得到一些指导，不妨去看看那本书和那些YouTube视频，这些指导来自我，

sentences.en: but also a collective of qualified and aspiring psychologists, 600 years worth of cumulative experience on offer in those pages.
sentences.zh: 也来自一个由合格的和有抱负的心理学家组成的集体，这些书页中凝聚了长达600年的经验。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I, my clinical specialty is working with trauma, depression, anxiety in adults.
sentences.zh: 所以我的临床专长是处理成人的创伤、抑郁和焦虑。

sentences.en: But I also do eating disorders work because I do find there is a great deal of crossover with trauma and eating disorders because of nature of, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我也会做进食障碍相关的工作，因为我发现由于某种性质，创伤和进食障碍之间有很多重叠，

sentences.en: control, which can be really key post-trauma.
sentences.zh: 也就是控制感，这在创伤后可能非常关键。

sentences.en: Before I was specializing in that and working with adults, I worked for four years in a CAMS service.
sentences.zh: 在我专注于这一领域并与成年人合作之前，我在一个儿童及青少年心理健康服务（CAMHS）机构工作了四年。

sentences.en: So that's what I did when I first qualified, worked in CAMS, which I loved.
sentences.zh: 这就是我刚取得资格时所做的工作，在CAMHS工作，我非常喜欢那段经历。

sentences.en: But I became a mummy for the first time whilst I was working in that service.
sentences.zh: 但在该机构工作期间，我第一次当上了妈妈。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, 26 miles each way in really, really heavy traffic on the M6.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，M6高速公路上单程就是26英里，而且车流量非常非常大。

sentences.en: And so a job came up closer to home that was a promotion.
sentences.zh: 因此，离家更近的地方出现了一个升职的工作机会。

sentences.en: And it felt like a bit of a no-brainer, even though it meant moving from my beloved children's services to adults.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一个不需要多想的决定，尽管这意味着要离开我热爱的儿童服务转向成人服务。

sentences.en: But actually, I rose to the challenge and have really, really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我勇敢地迎接了挑战，并且非常非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: And now I would happily call myself, you know, an adult specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 现在我可以很高兴地称自己为一个成人心理学专家了。

sentences.en: But it means that I also feel really comfortable in working with young people.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也意味着，我在与年轻人合作时也感到非常得心应手。

sentences.en: But currently, I am private practice only.
sentences.zh: 不过目前，我只做私人执业。

sentences.en: So in April 2021, so quite new, I left the NHS and now work solely in private practice.
sentences.zh: 所以在2021年4月，也就是不久前，我离开了NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系），现在完全从事私人执业。

sentences.en: And I only see adults in my clinic or age 16 and above anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我的诊所只接待成人，或者任何16岁及以上的人。

sentences.en: I don't see any of the younger ones anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不再接待任何年龄较小的孩子了。

sentences.en: And I am, due to the pandemic, I am online only.
sentences.zh: 而且由于疫情的原因，我现在只在线上接诊。

sentences.en: But that is likely to continue because it works well for me and it works well for my family.
sentences.zh: 但这很可能会继续下去，因为它对我很适合，对我的家庭也很适合。

sentences.en: I have a great resource that I've created called the Our Tricky Brain Kit, which is based on compassion-focused therapy theory for helping clients and staff teams
sentences.zh: 我创建了一个非常棒的资源，叫做“我们棘手的大脑工具包”（Our Tricky Brain Kit），它基于慈悲焦点疗法（CFT）理论，旨在帮助客户和员工团队

sentences.en: to understand the role of trauma and depression on mental health.
sentences.zh: 理解创伤和抑郁对心理健康的作用。

sentences.en: And I also am the lead author and put together the book, The Grief Collective, stories of life, loss and learning to heal.
sentences.zh: 同时我也是《悲伤集体：生活、失落与学习治愈的故事》（The Grief Collective, stories of life, loss and learning to heal）一书的第一作者和主编。

sentences.en: So if you would welcome learning some more about grief or you are grieving yourself, then you might really find it useful to check out that as a resource.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你想更多地了解悲伤，或者你正在经历悲伤，你可能会发现把这作为一种资源真的很有用。

sentences.en: It's available in paperback and e-book.
sentences.zh: 它有平装版和电子书版本。

sentences.en: And I'm working really hard on the e-book of The Clean Psycho Collective being available.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力让《临床心理学家集体》（The Clinical Psychologist Collective）的电子书上线。

sentences.en: So I'm hoping it will be available by the time you are listening to this.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望在你收听这个节目的时候它已经上架了。

sentences.en: But it's not behaving itself at the moment.
sentences.zh: 但它目前进展得并不是很顺利。

sentences.en: Right, we're just going to break for a short ad break.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们马上要进入一个简短的广告时间。

sentences.en: And I'll be back with the last part of this first podcast episode very soon.
sentences.zh: 很快我就会回来，带来这期播客节目的最后一部分。

sentences.en: I'm Jo, and I work as an assistant practitioner in a CAMS service in Lancashire.
sentences.zh: 我是乔，我在兰开夏郡的一家CAMHS机构担任助理执业医师。

sentences.en: I bought and read Marianne's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, to accompany me while completing the clinical psychology training application.
sentences.zh: 我购买并阅读了玛丽安的书《临床心理学家集体》，在完成临床心理学培训申请期间它一直陪伴着我。

sentences.en: It proved to be a really good company.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，它真的是一个很好的伴侣。

sentences.en: I found it sparked ideas of how to build experience and skills.
sentences.zh: 我发现它激发了我关于如何积累经验和技能的想法。

sentences.en: But more than that, it offered the chance to get lost in people's stories.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，它提供了一个沉浸在别人故事中的机会。

sentences.en: It provided a timely reminder not to get so caught up in an end goal and to value and enjoy each job we fulfil along the way.
sentences.zh: 它及时提醒我们，不要过于纠结于最终目标，而是要去珍视并享受我们在沿途完成的每一份工作。

sentences.en: Because the work we do now is important and matters to those we sit alongside as well as ourselves.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在所做的工作非常重要，对我们身旁的人以及我们自己都意义重大。

sentences.en: It also gave the reassurance that there are eclectic routes into clinical psychology, which is important for me as someone who's had a meandering journey
sentences.zh: 它还带给我一种安心感，让我知道通往临床心理学的道路是多元的，这对我这样一个经历曲折、

sentences.en: and not a typical route to the profession.
sentences.zh: 并非走常规路线进入这个行业的人来说非常重要。

sentences.en: I wholeheartedly recommend the book for both personal and professional reasons.
sentences.zh: 无论是从个人还是职业角度，我都由衷地推荐这本书。

sentences.en: Be prepared to put evening tasks on hold for a while, though, because once you've started reading, it's tough to put it down.
sentences.zh: 不过请做好准备，暂时把晚上的任务放一放，因为一旦你开始阅读，就很难把它放下了。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thanks for sticking with me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你一直陪伴着我。

sentences.en: I thought it would be useful to think about some of the upcoming themes that we've got scheduled for our future podcast episodes
sentences.zh: 我想思考一下我们为未来播客节目预定的部分即将推出的主题可能会很有用，

sentences.en: so that you know what's coming and you are hopefully, you know, subscribing to this podcast and telling anyone you think might find it useful.
sentences.zh: 这样你就知道接下来会有什么，并且希望你能够订阅这个播客，并把它推荐给任何你认为会有用的人。

sentences.en: But yeah, I understand and recall what it's like to be an aspiring psychologist that can feel incredibly competitive.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我理解并记起作为一个有抱负的心理学家是什么感觉，那会让人觉得竞争异常激烈。

sentences.en: So if you want to keep this as your own guilty pleasure, something that's useful, that's OK, too.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想把这当作你自己的小秘密，当作一件有用的东西留给自己，那也没关系。

sentences.en: So we are going to be thinking about using supervision and the supervisory relationship.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们将探讨如何利用督导以及督导关系。

sentences.en: We're going to be thinking about life events and psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨生活事件与心理学。

sentences.en: We're going to be thinking about, you know, teaching and training.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨教学与培训。

sentences.en: We're going to be thinking about, you know, conducting assessments and our relationships with clients.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨如何进行评估以及我们与客户的关系。

sentences.en: We're going to be thinking about issues of diversity and equality, thinking about, you know, research and other kind of ways of evaluating
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨多样性和平等问题，探讨研究以及其他评估服务内部情况的各种方式，

sentences.en: what might be going on within services as well.
sentences.zh: 了解服务中可能正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: So this is a really broad brush of the things I'm hoping you guys will find really, really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常广泛的概述，涵盖了我希望大家会觉得非常非常有用的内容。

sentences.en: But, you know, I do need to know from you what you would like to listen to.
sentences.zh: 但是，我确实需要从你们那里了解你们想听什么。

sentences.en: I've also got some ideas for thinking about money and financial planning.
sentences.zh: 我还有一些关于金钱和财务规划的想法。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's lots of cool stuff coming up.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有很多很酷的内容即将到来。

sentences.en: And actually, I wanted to put this podcast together because, you know, it can be really useful to have people that speak your language and hope you guys in terms of practicalities.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我想制作这个播客是因为，有那些与你使用同一种语言、在实用层面上真正理解并支持你的人，会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I hope this is you can understand me clear enough for you.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们能足够清楚地听懂我说的话。

sentences.en: That's not really what I meant.
sentences.zh: 其实我不是那个意思。

sentences.en: Sorry, we can be quite tricky with the way you speak, can't we sometimes?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，有时候我们说话的方式可能会让人有点难懂，对吧？

sentences.en: But, you know, someone that is on your page and kind of is getting you, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，总会有一个人与你在同一频道上，某种程度上懂你，

sentences.en: and the issues that are important and pertinent to you right now in order to, you know, progress your career.
sentences.zh: 了解那些对你来说至关重要、与你当前职业发展息息相关的问题。

sentences.en: Because we are a breed, you know, not like many others, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为我们这类人确实与众不同，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think our drive, certainly my own recollection of my drive to get to where I wanted to be, could be pretty relentless, you know.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的动力——当然我自己对达到目标的那种动力的回忆——可以说是相当执着的。

sentences.en: And people would be like, well, I don't get it.
sentences.zh: 人们会觉得，嗯，我不明白。

sentences.en: Like, well, I'll just get a different job or, you know, stay at Argos and, you know, go and be a buyer or something.
sentences.zh: 比如，我大不了换个工作，或者留在Argos百货去当个采购员什么的。

sentences.en: That doesn't light my fire, you know.
sentences.zh: 那点燃不了我的热情。

sentences.en: I really love this work.
sentences.zh: 我是真心热爱这项工作。

sentences.en: And so if that is you, if that describes you, then I am on your page.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果那就是你，如果这描述了你，那么我和你在同一个频道上。

sentences.en: And I am, you know, so keen to help you advance in your work with people.
sentences.zh: 并且我非常渴望帮助你在人们的工作中取得进步。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be running a free five-day challenge to further super boost your incredible abilities as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我将举办一个为期五天的免费挑战赛，以进一步极大地提升你作为一名有抱负的心理学家的非凡能力。

sentences.en: So look out for details about the free five-day challenge, which is coming very soon.
sentences.zh: 所以请留意关于这个免费五天挑战赛的详情，它很快就会推出。

sentences.en: And I will get the details to you on how you can register for that as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我会尽快将如何注册的详细信息发送给你们。

sentences.en: But the website address for the holding list for the mailing list is www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk and then forward slash the word aspire, A-S-P-I-R-E.
sentences.zh: 邮件列表候补名单的网址是 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk，后面斜杠加上单词 aspire，即 A-S-P-I-R-E。

sentences.en: And if you check that out, click on the link, you can get yourself on the mailing list for the next free five-day challenge.
sentences.zh: 如果你去查看那个网址，点击链接，你就可以把自己加入到下一次免费五天挑战赛的邮件列表中。

sentences.en: That will continue to run and will be continually updated with the details of when the next challenge is.
sentences.zh: 这个活动将会持续开展，并且会不断更新下一次挑战赛的具体细节。

sentences.en: So I hope you found our first episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你们会觉得我们《有抱负的心理学家》播客的第一期节目非常有用。

sentences.en: Please don't be shy.
sentences.zh: 请不要害羞。

sentences.en: Do let me know if you've got any feedback and rate and review this podcast and subscribe, of course.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何反馈，请务必让我知道，并为这个播客打分、写评论，当然还要订阅。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with you for the next episode next week.
sentences.zh: 我期待着在下周的下一期节目中与大家再次交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 那么，就让它成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your wish to aspire with Dr. Marianne.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在旁陪伴，在玛丽安医生的带领下，你将走上实现抱负的愿望之路。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能赚到超越“用时间换金钱”的钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推荐链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的额外福利，以及我个人独家的支持套餐，且无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、Fortnum and Mason的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的专属福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的专属福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在这里。
